name: Sawaki Souta
source:
Likes: Ramen
Hobby: Playing with [url=/c70384]Aoi[/url]

2nd year high school student. An 'Ayakashi-tsuki' who has mystic powers.
He has great grades and is good at sports.
He's also good with people and always has a smile on his face and is liked by all those around him.
He went to the same school as the protagonist when they were kids.
